goal.objective: Discover already materialized canonical first-cohort formalism/runtime source roots without chat selection, network checkout, or non-TV/TVC secrets/tokens, and persist a deterministic roots manifest for downstream workers.
success_predicates: All required first-cohort repositories resolve to exactly one canonical local root
Each resolved root contains a mirror handoff at repo root or docs
A deterministic non-secret roots manifest is persisted
No network checkout or credential path is used
failure_predicates: A missing repository is silently treated as materialized
Ambiguous duplicate roots are silently selected
A root without canonical handoff standing is accepted
GitHub/provider/wallet credentials are accepted or forwarded

task.derivation_reason: Existing formalism workers otherwise depend on chat-selected STEGVERSE_FORMALISM_ROOTS_JSON.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted heartbeat while one or more required source roots are unresolved or ambiguous

completion.next_authorized_action: Emit the discovered roots manifest; existing formalism/manifold workers consume it automatically. If any source is absent, derive a separately authorized materialization successor rather than requesting chat selection.
terminal_when: All required repositories are uniquely discovered with canonical mirror handoff standing

cosv.notation: L R U I V G O C M T B E A P
